Restaurant Style Jeera Rice Recipe
By: ravikumar
Published: Monday, June 4, 2018 - 10:44pm

Ingredients




1 cup Basmati rice
2 to 3 tablespoons Ghee/oil
chopped coriander leaves
1 teaspoon Lemon
Cumin seeds
1 Whole spices –
1 brown cardamom,
4 cloves,
7 to 8 peppercorns
1 cinnamon stick
Salt to taste

Preparation

1 In a pan add ghee, whole spices, cumin seeds and mix it together 2 Then add the cooked rice, salt, coriander leaves and mix it again 3 Jeera rice is ready to serve

About

Make Restaurant Style Jeera Rice Recipe at home with Minimal Ingredient like Rice, Ghee/oil, coriander leaves, Lemon, Cumin seeds, brown cardamom, cloves, peppercorns, cinnamon stick, Salt to taste. Make super-fast and very simple, easy and delicious Jeera Rice Recipe. It’s perfect for Lunch and dinner. It one of the most popular Restaurant Style Jeera Rice Recipe or Cumin Rice recipe.
